屄.definition:
A Chinese character, which combined by two characters/[radicals] 尸 (Body, Sitting human) and 穴 (Hole), results a [definition] of 屄 (Vagina, Vulva).

[Alternative]: 逼, 批, 毴, 𫵘
屄.example:
1. vulva or/and vagina; cunt
2. An intensifying modifier.
    心裡沒有一點屄數嗎？ MSC, trad.
    心里没有一点屄数吗？ MSC, simp.
    Xīnlǐ méiyǒu yī diǎn bī shù ma? Pinyin
    Is there not even a bit of fucking clue in [your heart]?
3. An intensifying object after a verb.
    裝屄 / 装屄  ―  zhuāngbī  ―  to pretend to be tough, capable or fierce; to pretend to be a chick
    撕逼  ―  sībī  ―  to have a cat fight; to have a '''bitch''' fight
4. An intensifying suffix after an [adjective].
    牛屄  ―  niúbī  ―  [fucking awesome]
    苦逼  ―  kǔbī  ―  fucking miserable
5. contemptible person, retard; May mean merely "person" in some compounds.
    傻屄  ―  shǎbī  ―  dumbfuck
    帥逼 / 帅逼  ―  shuàibī  ―  hot guy
    這逼幹活兒真磨嘰！

    这逼干活儿真磨叽！

    Zhè bī gànhuór zhēn mòji!
    Dis bitch be workin' slow AF.
